module: Rendering of the repair patch clusters (asphalt patches) of a Hero Road Editor road. Each cluster group.repairs[i] (created in the Features tab) becomes a pseudo-random fixed-seed scatter of decal instances placed on the roadway via editor.addDecalInstanceWithTan, with a DecalData shared per material. It is surface only: no impact on mesh, sidewalks or collision. The result is a pure function of the cluster's parameters and its seed, so identical after save or undo.
notes: The decal handles (userdata) are kept in a module store indexed by group.id, not on the group, because the group table is encoded into a buffer for undo/sessions and cannot serialize userdata.

Cluster parameters (default values): coverage 0.7, offset 0.0, lengthM 8.0 (min 0.5), sizeMin 0.6, sizeMax 1.4, density 0.6, t 0.5 (normalized position along the road), seed 1, rotJitter 1.0, material.
Number of patches = round(density * lengthM * band width), clamped between 1 and 300.

The material must be a real atlas decal material (asphalt_patches: 4 rows x 2 columns); frames 0 and 4 are ignored (patchFrames = 1,2,3,5,6,7). Render priority 6 (below the markings, 12+), lift-off of 0.03 m.
Road width: group.leftExtM / rightExtM, otherwise half of divWidths[1] (or 5 m).

clearRepairs.desc: Deletes the group's repair decal instances and their DecalData templates, then forgets its store entry. Called on every rebuild and at teardown.

updateRepairs.desc: Rebuilds the decal scatter of each placed cluster (first calls clearRepairs). Does nothing more if the road has no repairs, fewer than 2 divPoints, no binormals, no scene folder or a zero length.

group.desc: Hero Road group (repairs, divPoints, binormals, divWidths, sceneTreeFolderId).
